sources.title: Architecture graph for MinimaLabs/KLM-1.5. - hfviewer.com
sources.snippet: MinimaLabs/KLM-1.5 architecture at a glance MinimaLabs/KLM-1.5 is a text-generation model (klm architecture). It uses 24 transformer layers, a hidden size of 512, and 8 query heads with 4 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use an intermediate size of 1,408.
